_comment: Issue #207: the format gate beside the doc-bridge title gate, and the payload-shape rule that keeps a player off something that cannot be audio. Both live in src/core/CatalogMatch.cpp and are asserted by probe_resolver's two #207 sections.

mutants.name: silence-read-as-mismatch
mutants._why: The one change that would break the feature instead of fixing the bug: demanding a positive signal refuses every format-silent release, which is most of them.

mutants.name: wanted-format-ignored-when-both-named
mutants._why: A pack that carries the ebook AND the audiobook does contain what was asked for.

mutants.name: audiobook-shelf-asks-for-nothing
mutants._why: The shelf is the only side that knows what was wanted; if it answers Any the gate is inert.

mutants.name: work-title-not-cut-out
mutants._why: Without the cut, a book actually called 'The PDF Handbook' can never be found as an audiobook.

mutants.name: title-cut-stops-after-the-first-occurrence
mutants._why: A provider that names the work twice leaves a copy of the title behind, and for a book titled with a format word that copy reads as a format tag.
mutants.replace: if (run) { for (i += int(wantTokens.size()); i < tokens.size(); ++i) rest << tokens[i]; break; }

mutants.name: title-run-not-matched-token-by-token
mutants._why: The cut must find the work wherever it sits; a run accepted without comparing tokens eats a LEADING format tag and reads the release as silent.

mutants.name: format-word-matched-as-substring
mutants._why: The over-eager-normalisation failure this repo keeps hitting: 'PDF' inside PDFDrive is not a format tag.

mutants.name: zip-endpoint-reads-as-playable
mutants._why: The reported link exactly: no filename, no mime, a path verb. If this is Unknown the player opens on nothing again.
mutants.find: if (seg == QStringLiteral("zip") || seg == QStringLiteral("rar")) return PayloadShape::Archive;

mutants.name: zip-matched-as-substring-of-the-path
mutants._why: Same over-eager class on the other rule: an id containing the letters is not a zip endpoint.
mutants.find:
for (const QString& seg : path.split(QLatin1Char('/'), Qt::SkipEmptyParts))
        if (seg == QStringLiteral("zip") || seg == QStringLiteral("rar")) return PayloadShape::Archive;

mutants.name: declared-audio-mime-ignored
mutants._why: What the source says beats what the url looks like, or a zip endpoint serving audio is refused.

mutants.name: epub-mime-classified-as-an-archive
mutants._why: 'application/epub+zip' ends in zip; the document tests must be decided first so the message names what it is.

mutants.name: url-judged-whole-instead-of-its-path
mutants._why: A query string carries tokens and original filenames; reading one as a filename is reading a signature as a file.
